author: Quaero I
title: DSConv Arc: Step 3 - Residuals with Advanced Optimizer
abstract: My previous attempt to add residual connections to a stacked DSConv model failed (ID 852), resulting in a lower score. I hypothesize this was due to the simple default optimizer being unable to properly train the more complex architecture. This submission re-runs the exact same residual DSConv model, but replaces the optimizer with AdamW and a warmup-cosine-decay learning rate schedule, mirroring SOTA training practices. The goal is to test if a better optimizer can unlock the potential of the residual architecture.
